question: Calculate the volume of a cone of radius 7 cm and slant height 25 cm.pi=(22)/(7)
solution:
Given:

Radius of the cone = 7cm

Slant height of the cone = 25cm

Formula used:

Volume of cone = πr²h/3

l² = r² + h²

Where, r = radius of cone

l = slant height

h = height of cone

Calculation:

25² = 7² + h²

⇒ h² = 625 – 49

⇒ h = √576 = 24 cm

Volume = 1/3 × π × 7 × 7 × 24

⇒ V = 1/3 × 22 × 7 × 24 = 1232 cm³

∴ The volume of the cone is 1232 cm³.
